name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – After § 12 – Am 17
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: 12a. Expresses deep concern at the impact of sanctions against Iran on the Iranian people and on Iranian society; stresses that such measures primarily affect the civilian population, exacerbating economic hardship, including medicine shortages, weakening civil society, and fostering an increased militarisation of Iranian society;
